title: Cucumber Seeds
wikitext:
{{{{{1|Seeds Infobox}}} |image = Cucumber Seeds |Crop = Cucumber |Growth = 12 days |Season = {{Season|Spring}} |Sell Price = 75 |gPrice = {{GS Price|seeds|75}} |tPrice = {{Tprice|75}} |jPrice = {{JM Price|seeds|75}} }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' are a type of seed that can be planted in the {{Season|Spring}}. Mature plants yield [[Cucumber]] after 12 days and continue to produce every 2 days. Seeds can be purchased at [[Stardew:Pierre's General Store|Pierre's General Store]], [[JojaMart]], and at the Traveling Cart, but they can also be obtained by placing Cucumber in the [[Stardew:Seed maker|Seed Maker]]. Mature plants will produce 2 – 3 Cucumbers per harvest with a 3% chance of extra produce per harvest and a 20% chance of extra harvest per each [[Stardew:Farming#Farming Skill|Farming Skill]] level. ==Summary== {{#lst:Crop Summaries|Cucumber}} {{clear}}
